notes.title: 10/04/2024 Challenge mode ending added, better shotgun.
notes.content:
Challenge mode ending added
Buff shotgun damage with the rate of fire in exchange. - Recommended shot and switch gun for the best performance.
Remove the blinking screen when damaged, It's too bad for your eyes.
